recentItems.title: Leihlo La Sechaba | Women behind bars
recentItems.description:
There are over 4000 women incarcerated in South Africa’s correctional system, representing a small but highly vulnerable minority of the total inmate population. 

Leihlo La Sechaba visited a female prison at Thohoyandou, Venda Limpopo province. We spoke to women who are serving time for their various crimes they committed, from child neglect, rape and murder.
